history.period: Claimed more than 500 years old — weak sourcing, verify
history.summary: IDENTITY CONFIRMED (with qualifications): this row is the hilltop Maa Muktai Chandi Pahar Samadhi at Phulberya, Salanpur, a Chandi temple atop a hill with 200+ ratings on place listings. CSV TOWN FLAG: the CSV says Asansol, but the temple is NOT in Asansol city — it is at Phulberya, Salanpur block, PASCHIM BARDHAMAN district, roughly 13-17 km from Asansol city (temple.yatradham.org puts it 17.3 km from the Asansol bus station and 25.8 km from Kumardubi railway station). The temple is dedicated to Maa Muktai (a form of Chandi); one pilgrim-portal source claims it is more than 500 years old, but no historical record or dated inscription was found — treat the antiquity claim as unverified. The site holds a large annual fair.

name: Maa Muktai Chandi Temple
town_description: Salanpur is a block in Paschim Bardhaman district, West Bengal, in the coal-belt north-west of Asansol city. The Maa Muktai Chandi temple stands on a hill at Phulberya in Salanpur (pin 713357/713359), set in a calm, maintained hilltop complex.

travel.road: Phulberya, Salanpur — local transport from Asansol city (approx. 17 km from Asansol bus station)
